title: Gateway depot and cislunar traffic architecture audit
question: Audit the exact OTA-TEC-0087 draft and its dependencies OTA-TEC-0025, OTA-TEC-0082 and OTA-TEC-0084. Using real cislunar mission-design and propellant-depot literature only as external constraints, determine: (1) what can and cannot be inferred from 500 t depot capacity and 'about 15 CYGNUS flights' without inventing a partial-refill rule; (2) technical/logistical implications of long-duration cryogenic propellant storage if LH2/LOX is used, while keeping depot propellant type open unless canon specifies it; (3) whether the existing canon CYGNUS LEO→LLO plus PELICAN lunar-orbit↔surface is compatible with Gateway at an L2-associated halo/NRHO without an additional transfer leg, route variant or different PELICAN operating orbit; (4) plausible architecture options that preserve existing canon with the minimum new fictional assumptions; and (5) wording/reclassification needed in OTA-TEC-0087. Do not silently choose a new canonical traffic architecture. Distinguish established [R], plausible extrapolation [H], fictional setting [F], arithmetic/derived [T], and unresolved [OFFEN]. No NOXIA balancing changes.
why_now: Gateway cannot become AKTIV until its depot arithmetic and relationship to the existing CYGNUS/Pelican/LLO transport chain are internally closed.
real_world_anchor: Cislunar transfer architecture, lunar NRHO/LLO transfers, orbital propellant depots, cryogenic storage and logistics.
novelty_reason: First explicit cross-dossier closure audit of Gateway, CYGNUS, LLO/Tycho and PELICAN routing.
